en.basel-kadem: 1.	We were told by Muhammed bin Hasan bin Ahmad bin Waleed, may Allah grant him mercy, that he said: We were told by Muhammed bin Hasan al-Saffar, from Ahmad bin Muhammed, from Ali bin Hakam, and Mohsin bin Ahmad, from Aban bin Ahmar, from Abdul-Rahman bin Abi Abdillah, that he said: I asked Abu Abdillah, peace be upon him,
about the saying of Allah, Exalted and Glorious is He: «do not enter houses other than your houses until you domesticate (yourselves) and send peace upon their people.» [24:27]
He said: Domestication is to place the sandals and send peace.
